title: festuca nevadensis subsp. scabrescens
intro: Festuca nevadensis subsp. scabrescens, commonly known as a type of mountain fescue grass, is a plant species that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve wound healing due to its antiseptic and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Festuca nevadensis subsp. scabrescens include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may contribute to its potential use in the treatment of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
